overall_explanation: Reviewed the RAG-09 change bundle along the owner -> DCS -> retained manifest -> model result -> citation validation path. on the runtime side, packKnowledgeCandidates/packResolvedChatKnowledgeRef now emits whole units with intentId, source/chunk digests and retained byte counts, collectContextCandidate/finalizeContextCandidates record ordinal-based knowledge projections, and projectContextCandidates/retainedKnowledgeManifest only count projection records whose text is still present in the final messages, so the manifest matches what actually reaches the provider. Chat revalidation keeps conflict groups all-or-nothing and strips previously recorded knowledge messages when the group is dropped. The agent model-only QA path passes Main-owned sessionKey/workspaceId/workspaceDir plus owner pins (no bodies) with internal session effects, agent.wait returns the last model call's retainedEvidence only to operator.read/admin callers, and its extra result synchronization is bounded by the remaining original deadline using the exact runId dedupe key. Quote validation is bound to the post-model owner re-read (evidence = after) filtered by retained intentId and chunkDigest, with an explicit error when the source count changes, no retained source, or no DCS receipt. Known intentional behaviors confirm that whole conflict groups over budget are dropped atomically, explicit pins are owner-admitted, automatic retrieval defaults remain none/suggest, and queue/retry carry the existing send option pins. The supplied local gates (275 root tests, 54 runtime tests, node/web/test typechecks, Electron journey) are consistent with these paths; I found no remaining concrete regression in the reviewed code.
